description: Uses LZ-complexity of Collatz trajectories to find 'algorithmically deep' numbers with long but structured trajectories.
mathematical_formalization: Logical depth delta(n) ≈ D(n) - C_LZ(tau) * log(D(n)). High delta = long structured trajectory.
implementation_hypothesis: Encode trajectories as binary, compute LZ76, rank by delay/LZ_complexity ratio.
experiment_seed: All n up to 10^7, identify top 0.1% by delay/LZ ratio.
